note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(友谊主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When Tom broke his leg just before the big match, he was sure his teammates would soon forget all about him. Instead, his friends visited him every single day, brought him his homework, and even carried him outside to watch the final game. Tom finally understood that true friends are the ones who show up exactly when you need them most.

questions.q: Why did Tom think his teammates would forget him?
options: Because his injury meant he could no longer play in the match.
Because he had argued with the whole team.
Because he was moving to another town.
Because he had quit the sport on purpose.
questions.explanation: 短文开头 'broke his leg just before the big match… sure his teammates would soon forget' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: What did Tom finally come to understand?
options: That winning matters more than friendship.
That genuine friends appear right at your moment of need.
That he should find a new team.
That his friends were too busy for him.
questions.explanation: 末句 'true friends are the ones who show up exactly when you need them most' 的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。
